Trae2api-dsh

把 TRAE 账号的模型额度接入 dsh，直接在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用。

[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/FuSheng-cs/Trae2api-dsh?label=release)](https://github.com/FuSheng-cs/Trae2api-dsh/releases/latest) [![CI](https://github.com/FuSheng-cs/Trae2api-dsh/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/FuSheng-cs/Trae2api-dsh/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [English](README.en.md) · [下载](https://github.com/FuSheng-cs/Trae2api-dsh/releases/latest) · [使用指南](docs/usage.zh-CN.md) · [问题反馈](https://github.com/FuSheng-cs/Trae2api-dsh/issues) **Trae2api-dsh** 让 dsh 使用你在 TRAE CN / TRAE SOLO CN 账号中的模型额度。导入账号后，即可在 dsh 原生对话菜单选择 TRAE 模型和思考强度，使用该账号的额度进行对话。内嵌控制台提供多账号管理、自动签到、账号轮询、用量统计和模型显示设置。 [功能](#功能) · [界面](#界面预览) · [快速开始](#快速开始) · [日常使用](#日常使用) · [常见问题](#常见问题) · [项目文档](#项目文档) ## 功能 | 功能 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | **TRAE 额度接入** | 导入 TRAE 账号，在 dsh 中调用账号提供的模型并使用其模型额度。 | | **自动签到** | 按北京时间每日签到，跳过当天已签到账号；支持立即执行、上次与下次执行时间及结果查询。 | | **多账号管理** | 导入已登录的桌面账号或网页授权登录，切换当前账号，分别启用或禁用模型调用。 | | **账号轮询** | 在有效且启用的账号之间顺序轮询，或根据缓存的剩余积分排序调度。 | | **模型与思考强度** | 预置 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash，发现账号的 Remote / SOLO 模型，按实际能力提供 Low / High / Xhigh。 | | **模型显示管理** | 在控制台搜索、显示或隐藏模型，支持批量操作；刷新与重启后保留偏好，并同步至原生模型菜单。 | | **积分与用量** | 查看账号积分、Token、缓存、请求、消费记录和每日汇总。 | | **完整内嵌控制台** | 保留概览、账号与签到、消费记录、轮询与设置、模型测试；也可在浏览器新窗口打开。 | | **服务自动管理** | 首次准备后随 dsh 启动；完整退出、Host 结束或禁用插件时回收整个代理进程树。 | 自动签到和轮询默认关闭，可在控制台按需开启。关闭窗口到托盘时服务继续运行。 ## 界面预览 ![Trae2api-dsh 内嵌控制台](assets/embedded-console.png)
查看模型管理与思考强度菜单 ![发现模型并设置显示偏好](assets/model-catalog.png) ![dsh 原生模型与思考强度选择](assets/model-selection.png)
截图使用隔离测试数据；实际模型列表由账号返回。 ## 快速开始 ### 环境要求 | 环境 | 要求 | | --- | --- | | dsh | 已验证 **0.2.0-rc.2**，本机 Desktop / Web | | Node.js | **22+** | | Python | **3.10+**，包含 `venv` 和 `pip` | | 账号 | TRAE CN / TRAE SOLO CN，具有目标模型使用权限 | | 操作系统 | Windows 10/11；Linux 和 macOS 通过 CI 验证 | 本机 Web / CLI 安装需要 `pnpm` 10+；Desktop 使用自带的插件管理环境。首次准备需要联网下载 Python 依赖，无需 Docker。 ### 安装 **Desktop**：在 dsh 插件管理器的添加包入口输入以下地址，安装并启用后打开侧栏 **TRAE 控制台**。 ```text https://github.com/FuSheng-cs/Trae2api-dsh/releases/latest/download/trae2api-dsh.tgz ``` **本机 Web / CLI**： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/FuSheng-cs/Trae2api-dsh/releases/latest/download/trae2api-dsh.tgz dsh web ``` 可在 [Release](https://github.com/FuSheng-cs/Trae2api-dsh/releases/latest) 下载固定版本和 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。不同市场的收录情况见 [市场记录](MARKETPLACES.md)，未收录的市场可能限制安装来源。 ### 首次配置 1. 打开 **TRAE 控制台 → 服务设置**，点击 **准备环境**，完成后点击 **启动服务**。 2. 选择 **TRAE SOLO CN** 或 **Trae CN**，点击 **导入当前桌面账号**；也可返回控制台使用网页授权登录。 3. 在 **DSH 模型管理** 点击 **接入 dsh 模型菜单**。 4. 在对话输入框选择模型和思考强度；模型显示或隐藏仍在控制台中管理。 首次启动不会自动导入账号。导入由你主动触发，TRAE 客户端登录文件保持只读。模型名称、可选档位与可用额度以账号返回为准。 ## 日常使用 | 要做什么 | 控制台入口 | | --- | --- | | 添加、切换账号，设置模型调用开关 | **账号与签到** | | 设置每日签到或立即执行 | **账号与签到 → 自动签到** | | 开启顺序轮询或积分优先模式 | **轮询与设置 → 多账号轮询** | | 刷新模型、搜索、逐个或批量显示/隐藏 | **DSH 模型管理** | | 查看积分、Token 和消费记录 | **概览 / 消费记录** | | 准备环境、启动或停止代理 | 顶部 **服务设置** | 积分优先模式使用已缓存的余额排序，可先在账号页刷新积分。隐藏模型会从 dsh 的模型目录移除该项，请先切换仍在使用它的会话；隐藏全部后，重新显示任一模型即可恢复。 ## 运行与更新 插件使用独立 Python 环境和本机回环地址。准备完成后自动管理代理生命周期，保留其他供应商和全局模型默认值。账号副本、设置和显示偏好保存在插件自己的数据目录，更新会刷新运行文件并保留这些数据。 项目原名为 `dsh-trae-relay`。从旧包升级请先断开模型、停止并移除旧插件，再添加新包；数据目录和 credential 标识保持兼容。详细步骤见 [升级与数据管理](docs/usage.zh-CN.md#从旧包升级)。 ## 常见问题 **关闭 dsh 窗口会停止代理吗？** 关闭到托盘时继续运行；完整退出 dsh、Host 结束或禁用插件时停止代理和签到任务。 **为什么模型列表或思考档位不同？** 插件读取当前账号返回的目录。未提供的档位不会显示，没有公布思考档位的模型使用上游默认行为。切换账号后刷新目录即可。 **端口被占用或找不到 Python 怎么办？** 在服务设置中填写可用的 Python 完整路径，或停止服务后选择空闲端口重新准备。网络下载与环境排查见 [使用指南](docs/usage.zh-CN.md)。 **支持国际版或远程浏览器吗？** 当前面向中国版协议和本机 Desktop / Web。完整控制台使用 Host 回环地址，远程浏览器场景尚未支持。 **卸载会删除账号吗？** 卸载保留插件数据。先断开模型、停止服务；需要彻底清理时再按使用指南移除数据与 credential。 ## 项目文档 | 文档 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | [使用指南](docs/usage.zh-CN.md) | 详细配置、签到轮询、模型管理、存储、升级和卸载 | | [贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.md) | 目录结构、本地开发、隔离测试和发布流程 | | [版本记录](CHANGELOG.md) | 各版本的变更 | | [市场记录](MARKETPLACES.md) | 已上架渠道与待审申请 | CI 在 Windows、Ubuntu、macOS 上验证插件测试、真实 dsh 安装、模型同步和服务退出回收；测试使用合成账号，不涉及个人凭据或付费推理。欢迎通过 [Issues](https://github.com/FuSheng-cs/Trae2api-dsh/issues) 报告问题。 --- 反代引擎和原有管理界面来自 [autumnsentiment/Trae2api-cn](https://github.com/autumnsentiment/Trae2api-cn) v1.0.4，保留上游版权与许可。相关说明：[MIT 许可](LICENSE) · [第三方说明](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) · [使用边界与免责声明](DISCLAIMER.md)。

plugins.description: 给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）加一段视频开机片头：启动时全屏播放 mp4、点击或 Esc 跳过、可导入自己的视频（解不了的编码自动转码成 H.264）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-boot-video

**给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）加一段视频开机片头。**
启动客户端时全屏播放你的 mp4，播完淡出、露出真正的界面；点击画面或按 `Esc` 随时跳过。

*Full-screen video boot splash for DSH.*

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-boot-video?label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-boot-video) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/xufu5438-netizen/dsh-boot-video?label=GitHub)](https://github.com/xufu5438-netizen/dsh-boot-video)

![桌面版实机预览：视频铺满窗口，左下角「打开声音」、右下角「点击画面跳过」](docs/preview-desktop.png)

---

## 特性

- 🎬 **一段 mp4 = 一次开机片头**：全屏播放，播完淡出进界面，不是"加载完成就切走"
- ⏭️ **随时跳过**：点击画面或按 `Esc`
- 🔊 **桌面版直接带着声音播出**（Electron 默认允许未静音自动播放）；网页版会被浏览器拦下，于是自动降级成静音并亮出「打开声音」按钮（点它只开声、不跳过）
- 🖥️ **盖住 DSH 自己的开机卡片**：首帧由宿主半边在文档解析阶段注入，`HARNESS / Loading plugins…` 不会露脸
- 🔀 **不跟别的片头插件打架**：各写自己的 localStorage 键，同时装也不会互相干扰
- 🖼️ **不裁画面**：始终按完整比例居中显示；片源自带的那圈黑边在压制素材时就裁掉了
- 📦 **零运行时依赖**：宿主半边只用 `node:` 内建模块，浏览器半边只有一条 `<video>`
- ⚙️ **设置单开一页**：设置侧边栏里的「开机动画」，开关 / 素材 / 预览都在那儿，不挤在「通用设置」里
- 🩺 **自检行**：设置页底部写着"客户端半边是什么时候加载的、上次开机到底播成功没有"——
  改了没生效 / 视频打不开，看一眼就知道
- 🔄 **导入的视频会自动转码**：解不了的编码（典型是 HEVC / H.265）不用你自己动手转——
  插件自己下 ffmpeg（国内镜像）转成 H.264 再收下，转完先验一遍能不能播

## 安装

```sh
# 从 npm 安装（推荐）
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-boot-video

# 从 GitHub 安装（仓库带构建产物，没有安装期脚本，不触发构建授权）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:xufu5438-netizen/dsh-boot-video

# 或从本地目录安装（把路径换成你解压出来的目录）
dsh plugin --profile web add <本目录绝对路径>
```

装完**必须重启一次 DSH**（bundle 在启动时装配），然后 **Ctrl+Shift+R** 硬刷新——
DSH 的客户端 bundle 带 `max-age=31536000, immutable`，普通 F5 会一直用第一次抓到的副本。

> **桌面版（Electron）**：也可以在应用里走「设置 → 插件 → 添加插件」贴本目录路径（插件管理器原生支持
> 本地路径 / registry / git / tarball 四种 spec）。桌面版的 index 注入表在宿主启动时收集一次，
> 所以那里装完必须**完全退出并重新打开**，刷新页面不够。

### 卸载

```sh
# 命令行装的
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-boot-video
```

桌面版在「设置 → 插件」里点卸载即可。**卸载后开机会恢复成 DSH 自己的启动画面**——
本插件不留下任何全局改动（只写自己那几个 localStorage 键；想彻底还原则在控制台删掉
`dsh-boot-video:source` / `dsh-boot-video:asset` / `dsh-boot-video:last-boot` 三个键）。

### 自己打"发布包"（只带已授权的那段）

```sh
npm run pack:release
```

它会临时把「月读世界」那段从包内容里排除、打完立刻还原清单，并**核对包里到底有什么**
（一旦混进没授权的素材，它会删掉包并以非零码退出）。当前结果：**11.37 MB**，只含
`assets/hdd.mp4` + 代码 + 一张预览图。

## 使用

**设置 → 侧边栏「开机动画」**（0.3.0 起是独立一页，不再挂在「通用设置」里）：

| 控件 | 档位 | 效果 |
|---|---|---|
| 启动时播放 | **我的视频**（默认） | 启动时全屏播一短片头，播完淡出进界面 |
| | **不播放** | 启动直通界面（想恢复：设置页里点回「我的视频」，或在控制台删掉 `localStorage['dsh-boot-video:source']`） |
| 片头素材 | **HDD**（默认） | `assets/hdd.mp4`，10.47 MB |
| | **月读世界** | `assets/yuedu.mp4`，29.01 MB，4K/60fps 重压（CRF 24、PSNR 46.2 dB，肉眼无差） |
| 导入自己的视频 | **⬆ 导入视频** | 挑一段你自己的 mp4（上限 512 MB），存进插件的 `assets/user/`，以后随时能选、能删 |
| 预览 | **▶ 播放一遍** | 不重启就看看效果；正在播时点它会从头重播 |

换素材会立刻用新素材重播一遍——不用为了确认换了没有去重启。

### 导入自己的视频（0.8.0 起默认开启）

点「⬆ 导入视频」挑一段 mp4，它会被**原样存进插件的 `assets/user/`**（不转码、不重封装——
导进去什么样，播出来什么样），然后自动选上、播一遍，**并弹出起名窗口**。这是本插件的主功能之一；
不想让插件能写盘的话，跑 DSH 时设 `DSHBV_IMPORT=0` 就能把它关掉（客户端那侧对应 `IMPORT_ENABLED`）。

- **素材带**里点它 = 换成它；旁边的小「×」= 从插件里删掉这一份（**你自己的原片不受影响**）
- 下面的「我导入的视频」列表负责「改名」与「删除」；改名**只改显示名**（磁盘文件名不动），
  留空 = 回到原始文件名
- 网页版与桌面版都能导，插件内部走的是两条路：
  - **网页版**：文件本体流式传给 DSH（带进度条），宿主边收边写盘
  - **桌面版**：Electron 能把"你刚选的那个文件"翻成绝对路径，于是**宿主直接复制**，几百 MB 也很快；
    这条路不通（旧版 Electron / 跨盘 / 没权限）会自动回退到上传那条
- 想手动清也可以：直接删掉 `assets/user/` 里那几个 `u-*.mp4`（清单是按目录推导的，不会留残影）；
  自定义名字在同目录的 `labels.json` 里，删掉它就全回到原始文件名
- **导入的内容只在你机器上**：发布包里没有别人的视频，别人导入的也不会传到你这儿

#### ⚠️ 只收 **mp4**；编码不支持的**会自动转码**

导入只认 `.mp4`（不是 mp4 会在选择器与本地校验那里就拦住）。至于"里面是什么编码"——
**不用你操心**：

| 你手上的文件 | 会发生什么 |
|---|---|
| `.mp4` + H.264（剪映/手机导出、B 站下载的常见形态） | ✅ 直接导入 |
| `.mp4` + HEVC（不少"4K 片源"） | 🔄 导入时会问一句「要不要自动转换」，点一下插件自己把 ffmpeg 下下来（约 28MB，国内镜像）转成 H.264，转完自动收进素材列表 |
| 其它容器（`.mkv` / `.webm` / `.mov`） | ❌ 被拒；先剪成 mp4（剪映导出选 mp4 + H.264 最省事） |
| 不是视频的文件 | ❌ 被拒（"没找到视频轨"） |

转码用的是 `libx264 -crf 20`、**保持原分辨率与帧率**、音频 AAC 192k、`+faststart`；
转完插件**自己先验一遍能不能播**才收下。命令行等价物（不想用界面时）：

```sh
node scripts/import-hevc.mjs "D:\视频素材\你的母带.mkv"
```

> ⚠️ 导入的视频就在插件文件夹里，所以**重装/升级插件时可能被覆盖**——重装前先把
> `assets/user/` 里那几个文件挪出去，装完再放回来。

画面**不做裁切**：始终按完整比例居中显示。窗口比例与片子比例不一致时上下（或左右）会留黑边——
这是"保留全部画面"的代价。片源自带的那圈黑边已经在压制素材时裁掉了，剩下的黑边只是比例差。

> 曾经做过「铺满 / 完整」两档，看过两档之后决定删掉「铺满」：16:9 窗口播一条 2.35:1 的片子，
> 铺满要裁掉左右各约 12%，那是画面少了一块，不是更饱满。

- **桌面版（Electron）自动带声音播放**；网页版浏览器会拦未静音自动播放，于是自动降级静音、
  左下角亮出「打开声音」按钮（点它只开声，不跳过）。同一份代码，两边各得其所。

### 想让网页版也自动带声音？

做不到由插件说了算——网页里的 JS 绕不过浏览器的自动播放策略，只有 Electron 这种"自己就是浏览器"
的宿主能设 `no-user-gesture-required`。**但可以手动给这个站点开声音白名单**，开完插件一个字都不用改
（它本来就是"先试带声、被拒才降级"）：

| 浏览器 | 操作 |
|---|---|
| **Chrome / Edge（推荐，不用手输网址）** | 在 DSH 页面上点地址栏左边的站点图标 → 「网站设置」→ 找到「声音」→ 改成**允许** → 硬刷新 |
| Chrome | `chrome://settings/content/sound` → 「允许播放声音」→ 添加 `http://127.0.0.1:3080` |
| Edge | `edge://settings/content/sound` → 「允许播放声音」→ 添加；或在 `edge://settings/content/mediaAutoplay` 里把「媒体自动播放」设为**允许**（这一条是全局放宽，所有网站都会自动放声，不如前两个精准） |

生效后硬刷新页面，播放时左下角的「🔊 打开声音」按钮**不再出现**，就是已经在自动带声播了
（地址要写全，别漏端口）。
- 点击画面 / 按 `Esc` 跳过，跳过后仍然走同一段淡出，不会硬切
- 每次客户端加载都会播（刷新页面也算）
- 播放期**不会**等待 DSH 的加载状态：播完就淡出，无论应用早就绪还是在加载

## 换成你自己的视频

```sh
node scripts/make-asset.mjs <你的母带.mp4> --height 1440 --crf 22
```

**片源自带的黑边要在这一步裁掉**，播放器再怎么 `object-fit` 也去不掉"画出来的黑边"。
先用 `ffmpeg -vf cropdetect=24:16:0 -f null -` 看出黑边高度，再传给 `--crop`：

```sh
node scripts/make-asset.mjs <你的母带.mp4> --crop 2560:1086:0:177 --crf 22
```

脚本用 devDependency `@ffmpeg-installer/ffmpeg`（纯 npm 包，国内镜像可装，不需要访问 GitHub）把母带转成
**H.264 + AAC + yuv420p + faststart** 的 mp4：浏览器与 Electron 都能直接播，
体积通常压到 5–10 MB。

也可以直接手工替换 `assets/hdd.mp4`，只要满足：

| 项 | 要求 |
|---|---|
| 容器/编码 | `.mp4`，**H.264 视频 + AAC 音频**（H.265/HEVC 在 Chromium 里多半放不出） |
| 体积 | 建议 ≤ 15 MB（这个文件要随包分发，别人下载的是它） |
| 时长 | 建议 ≤ 20 秒，且一定要能跳过 |
| 分辨率 | 1080p/1440p 都行，播放时按 `object-fit: contain` 等比铺满 |

## 兼容与限制

- 要求 **DSH >= 0.2.0-rc.1**（`package.json#dsh.engines`）：宿主半边依赖 `webserver/index-inject`
  的行渲染行为与 `webServer.register` 的原始 `(req, res)` 契约
- 只能在 **Web UI 加载之后**覆盖全屏，做不到早于 Electron 窗口首帧（窗口本身仍有一瞬间空白）
- 首帧是一块**纯色**（`#000000`），不是视频的第一帧画面——它只负责在插件求值前占住屏幕
- 网页版**不可能**自动播放还带声音：浏览器拦未静音自动播放，只能静音起步、点一下开声
- 视频文件随包走（不是内联 base64），由宿主路由流式返回，支持 Range / 206 / 304

## 素材与许可

**代码 MIT。**

**内置素材分两段，授权状态不同，发布包只带第一段：**

| 素材 | 来源 | 状态 |
|---|---|---|
| `assets/hdd.mp4`（HDD 开机动画） | B 站 UP 主 **[@露霁luki_yo](https://space.bilibili.com/3537104783018790)** 的《Hollow Deep Dive System》(HDD) | ✅ **已获作者授权**，可随包分发 |
| `assets/yuedu.mp4`（欢迎来到月读世界） | 从电影片段剪出的几秒 | ⛔ **未获授权**——只在本机自用，**不进发布包** |

所以对外发布的那份只有 HDD 一段（用 `npm run pack:release` 打，见下）。
`yuedu.mp4` 不在仓库里，你自己那份请保留在 `assets/`，本地两段都能用。

## 文档

| 文档 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| [视频开屏方案.md](../视频开屏方案.md) | 立项方案：路线对比、素材实测、限制清单（本机文档，不在仓库内） |
| [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) | 版本记录 |

## 致谢

- **HDD 开机动画素材由 B 站 UP 主 [@露霁luki_yo](https://space.bilibili.com/3537104783018790) 授权提供**——
  《Hollow Deep Dive System》(HDD) 是他的作品，插件内置的那段片头就是它（压缩与裁边见 `scripts/make-asset.mjs`）。
- 首帧抢屏与"盖住开机卡片"的做法，最初由 [dsh-550c-boot](https://github.com/yannicksong0106/dsh-550c-boot)
  （Ziyang Song / Voidpoket）验证并记录；本插件沿用同一套宿主契约。

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Manually resume an interrupted DSH conversation: /continue and an action-row action pick the run up exactly where it stopped.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-continuechat

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Manually resume an interrupted DeepSeek Harness conversation.

When a turn ends early — stopped by hand, cut short by a failed model request, or truncated by the output-token limit — the harness leaves nothing behind but a "stopped" marker. This plugin adds the missing step: a `/continue` command and a **Continue** action in the action row under the interrupted reply itself, so the run picks up exactly where it stopped instead of restarting.

## What it solves

| Situation | Without the plugin | With the plugin |
|---|---|---|
| You hit stop by accident | Retype "continue" yourself | Click **Continue** |
| A network or provider failure aborted the turn | Restate the context before the model resumes | The plugin hands the recorded failure to the model and resumes |
| The reply was cut off by the token limit | The harness says *send "continue"* — with no entry point | One click or one command continues the answer |

## Usage

### Command

```
/continue
/continue also fix the remaining three files
```

Text after the command name is appended to the continuation prompt as an "Additional instruction from the user" line.

The command's outcome (`已请求继续对话（中断原因：手动停止）。`) is rendered by the harness command plane; it never becomes a model message.

### Button

On the turn that was cut short, a **Continue** action appears in the action row under the closing assistant message — the same row that carries copy / thumbs-up / thumbs-down / branch:

- **It only appears on a real interruption.** Turns that completed, were blocked, or merely closed a fork show nothing, so the button never shows up under a conversation that ended normally.
- Only the assistant message that closes that turn carries it; every other message renders nothing and takes no space.
- It disappears again once the agent is running.
- Clicking it is exactly one `/continue` execution.
- A failed attempt keeps a short error line next to the action (hover for the full text).

The decision comes from the session's durable event window: the newest `turn/end` must have a resumable reason *and* that turn must carry a **persistent** assistant message. A turn that was interrupted **before producing any assistant output** (a request that failed outright, a process that died before streaming) therefore has nowhere to host the button — use the `/continue` command there.

### Command menu

Type `/` and pick `continue` ("Continue the interrupted conversation from where it stopped"). Arrow keys plus Enter are enough — no draft typing required.

## How it works

### Interruption tracking (host half)

The plugin subscribes to the session log's `session/event` and tracks every turn end:

| `reason.kind` | Meaning | Resumable |
|---|---|---|
| `aborted` | Run cancelled. `reason.reason.kind` refines it: `user` stopped by hand, `parent` stopped by a parent operation, `hook` stopped by a harness hook, `disposed` session torn down | ✅ |
| `error` | Model request failed (network, auth, server) | ✅ |
| `max-tokens` | Reply truncated by the output-token limit (not a context-window overflow) | ✅ |
| `interrupted` | Turn closed by crash recovery after the host process was interrupted | ✅ |
| `completed` | Finished normally | ❌ |
| `blocked` | Step refused by `agent/pre-step` before entering | ❌ |
| `forked` | Fork seed closing an inherited prefix (the start of a new session) | ❌ |

Any later `user/message` clears the record — either the user took over, or the plugin already resumed the run.

### The continuation prompt

`/continue` does not send a bare "continue". It queues a structured user message:

```
<continue-conversation>
The previous turn ended early: the run was stopped by hand.
Continue the interrupted work in this same session, from exactly where it stopped:
- Do not restart the task, re-summarize, or repeat output and work that is already visible above.
- Treat the current workspace, tool results, and durable session state as authoritative; …
- If a tool call was interrupted, verify its outcome before retrying it, and never blindly retry an operation that may have side effects.
- Finish the remaining work, then verify the result before reporting it.
Failure recorded by the harness: <what the harness logged when the turn died>
Additional instruction from the user: <text typed after the command>
</continue-conversation>
```

The first line is rewritten per reason (stopped by hand / request failed / reply cut off / crash recovery), and the harness-recorded failure text is attached so the model knows *why* the turn ended — which is what decides between continuing to write and re-checking an interrupted tool call first.

### Why the answer is a separate message

After you press **Continue**, DSH opens a new turn for the model to write on, and the plugin then retires that turn's trigger prompt from the transcript — so you no longer see the prompt, and the interrupted reply is followed directly by the new text.

The retirement is a `system/message` replacement, and the log makes such an event *step-scoped*: its `turn`/`step` must name the step that is open as it lands, and both coordinates must be positive (`dsh-session-format-v3-to-v4/lib/index.js`, `assertV4SystemMessageFields` plus the relationship replay). A turn that has already ended names no open step, so the replacement cannot be written there. It rides the step that produced the model's answer to the prompt — or, for a turn that produced none, the next step that opens.

The new text **cannot be merged into the original message**. That is an architectural constraint of the DSH session log, not an implementation shortcut:

- The log is event-sourced: a committed assistant message cannot be edited, only shadowed by a surface `replace`.
- A `replace` must list every shadowed node in `sourceEventSeqs` (`dsh-session/lib/index.js:327`), while `assistant/message` is explicitly forbidden from carrying that field (`:313`, it embeds its provider stream). The two rules conflict, so no assistant event can perform a replacement.
- Shadowing the whole range with a `system/message` instead would also shadow the `tool/call` / `tool/result` pairs inside it, breaking the model history so the next request fails.

The provider side has no assistant prefill either (`dsh-llm-deepseek` carries only anthropic-beta flags), so the model cannot literally continue the previous assistant message — it must generate a new one.

The result: **no stray "continue" prompt, but still a separate new answer.**

### Message shape

The continuation message is built by hand as `{ id, role: 'user', content: [{ type: 'text', text }], source: { kind: 'continue-chat' } }` and frozen:

- **The `id` is mandatory.** `Agent.inbox` deduplicates pending messages by `message.id` (a duplicate throws `already pending`) and never mints one, so the plugin generates it with `randomUUID()` from `node:crypto`.
- **`source.kind` is `continue-chat`.** Chat classifies a `user/message` by its source kind: `user` would render the prompt as a human bubble, while any other kind renders it as an injected-context node — and a context node whose content is plain text stays out of the visible node set. Never use `'plugin'` either: that is only the legacy format-v3 shape and format v4 rejects it when reading a log back.
- As a result the host half imports **nothing but `node:crypto`**: no `peerDependencies`, and therefore no exposure to the plugin version-compatibility gate.

### The browser half

The client half does exactly two things:

1. Registers the `continue-chat` dictionaries (zh/en).
2. Registers one action in the `conversation.chat.assistant-actions` slot. That slot's owner prop is `messageId` and its entries render inside Chat's `MessageIconActions` — the very component that owns copy / rating / branch — so the button lands in that row by construction.

Clicking it runs `ctx.remote.commands.execute(sessionId, '/continue', [])`, the same path a hand-typed `/continue` takes, so command lifecycle records, result rendering, and logging all stay identical.

Whether a message belongs to an interrupted turn is answered by the session's own durable event window: `ctx.s

# dsh-hard-delete

> **仓库**：<https://github.com/qwe4888789/dsh-hard-delete>
> **许可**：AGPL-3.0-only（+ 商业授权，见第九节） ｜ **版本**：v0.1.0 ｜ **类型**：cordis 插件（host + client 双半，零运行时依赖）

在 DSH 的侧边栏会话「…」菜单里加一行 **删除** —— 点一下就把这个会话**彻底删掉**：

- **不可恢复**：直接物理删除，不进回收站、没有回滚。
- **不设门槛**：不看「疑似还在活动」，不要求二次输入，只弹一次确认框（因为不可逆）。
- **当前会话也能删**：确认框会明确提示「这正是你当前打开的会话，删完请切换或刷新」。
- **删完整**：会话目录之外，还清掉指向它的 projcache 条目与 `workspace.json` 引用，
  避免留下悬空元数据。

> 与同机另一个插件 **`dsh-session-recycle`** 的分工：
> 那个是设置页里的「软删 → 回收站 → 恢复 / 回滚」，保守、可救回；
> 这个是菜单里的一键硬删。两者互不干扰（本插件不碰 `_recycle-bin/`）。

---

## 一、形态与注册

本插件**同时**声明 `dsh.bundle` 与 `dsh.client`，因此走 **bundle 层**注册：

```json
"dsh": {
  "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" },
  "client": { "inject": [], "platform": "web" }
}
```

> `dsh.client.inject` 刻意留空：本插件浏览器半只 `require("react")`（平台种子词）。
> 为什么不去 require 官方 UI 组件库，见第六节第 7 条。

> ⚠️ 只有 `dsh.client` 而**没有** `dsh.bundle` 的插件不能进 `dsh.profile.bundles` ——
> 宿主会以 `declares no dsh.bundle` 拒绝并**启动即崩**。本插件两个都声明了，所以不受此限。

装到某个 profile：

```bash
# 方式 A（推荐）：让 DSH 自己装 —— 桌面端「插件 → 添加插件」里粘贴本仓地址，
#   或命令行（profile 名按你的实际环境改）：
dsh plugin --profile web add qwe4888789/dsh-hard-delete

# 方式 B：声明式手工安装
#   在 <DSH_HOME>/profiles/<name>/package.json 里
#     dependencies:        { "dsh-hard-delete": "link:<本仓路径>" }
#     dsh.profile.bundles: 追加 "dsh-hard-delete"
cd <DSH_HOME>/profiles/<name> && pnpm install
# 重启 DSH
```

> 桌面版（DeepSeek Harness 桌面端）的 `desktop` profile 由 Electron 应用独占，
> 别用 `dsh plugin --profile desktop …`（CLI 会直接拒绝）；桌面端请走「插件 → 添加插件」。

---

## 二、两个槽位

| 槽位 | 挂什么 | 为什么 |
|---|---|---|
| `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` | 菜单里的「删除」行（id `hard-delete`，order **500**，排在 archive 的 400 之后） | owner 注入 `{ sessionId, displayTitle }` 与 `useMenuOpenState` 钩子 |
| `shell.overlay` | 确认框 + 结果提示 | **必须挂在常驻浮层上**：确认框若挂在菜单项里，菜单一关它就跟着卸载了 |

菜单项只做一件事：把「待确认请求」写进模块级小 store，然后关掉菜单。
浮层里的对话框读同一个 store，所以在菜单卸载后依然活着。

界面**自绘**（官方 `MenuItemButton` / `Modal` / `Button` / `Toast` 拿不到，见第六节第 7 条），
但完全照官方 `Menu.module.css` 的规格来：`min-height:34px` / `padding:6px 8px` /
`gap:6px` / `border-radius: var(--dsw-radius-md)` / hover 用
`--dsw-alias-interactive-bg-hover`，危险行用 `--dsw-alias-state-error-primary` +
`--dsw-alias-interactive-bg-hover-danger`。DOM 也与官方同构：
`div > [role=separator] + button[role=menuitem]` —— 菜单的键盘遍历与焦点回收都是读 DOM 的，
自绘按钮同样能参与。每个 `var()` 都写了兜底值，主题变量缺失时不会变成透明。

---

## 三、host 半的路由

前缀可配（默认 `/api/dsh-hard-delete`），全部 **loopback-only + same-origin 校验**。

| 方法 | 路径 | 请求体 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/config` | — | 公开配置（`apiPrefix` / 文案覆盖 / 开关 / `configErrors`），**不含绝对路径** |
| POST | `/inspect` | `{sessionId}` | 一个会话的概况：标题 / 工作目录 / 大小 / 文件数 / 有无线索日志 |
| POST | `/delete` | `{sessionId, confirm:true}` | **彻底删除**（不可逆） |

错误统一 `{ error, code }`。值得注意的 code：`session-not-found`(404)、
`confirm-required`(400)、`invalid-sessionId`(400)、`path-escape`(400)、
`loopback-only`(403)、`body-too-large`(413)。

返回列表里**不含任何绝对路径**——界面只显示标题 / 工作目录 / 大小 / 文件数。

---

## 四、删一个会话要动几处

```
<DSH_HOME>/
├─ sessions/<projectKey>/<sessionId>/
│  └─ session[.v<N>].jsonl[.zstd]        ← ① 整个目录物理删除（多版本日志一起）
├─ storages/
│  ├─ session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json  ← ② 新版：每会话一个文件
│  ├─ session_projcache.json                ← ③ 旧版：tables.sessions[<id>]
│  └─ workspace.json                        ← ④ archivedSessionIds / pinnedSessionIds
│                                              / tables.workspaces[*].sessionIds
└─ （浏览器那一边）
   └─ ctx.emit('api-session/removed', id)   ← ⑤ 让侧边栏那一行立刻消失
```

安全性质：

- **路径纵深防御**：`sessionId` 必须是单层路径段（挡 `.` / `..` / 分隔符 / NUL），
  定位后再用 `relative()` 确认最终目录没跑出 `sessions/`。
- **只认精确路径**：只在 `sessions/<任意项目目录>/<精确的 sessionId>` 下动手，
  绝不复刻宿主的目录名编码规则（也就不会被规则变化带偏）。
- **不覆盖、不猜**：定位不到就是 404，什么都不做。
- **元数据清理失败不冒充删除失败**：降级成 `warnings` 如实回传，界面照实提示。
- **原子写 JSON**：先写 `.tmp-<pid>-<ts>` 再 rename，网络盘上失败也不留半个文件。
- **只读探测**：`/inspect` 全程不写盘。

---

## 五、七个实测踩出来的坑（本节是这份代码最有价值的部分）

1. **多帧 zstd：Node 的同步接口只解第一帧。** DSH 的会话日志是**多帧拼接**的。
   `zstdDecompressSync(整个文件)` 实测在 107 KB 的文件上只吐 187 字节（就第一帧），
   `zlib.createZstdDecompress()` 流也一样停在第一帧。必须按 magic `28 B5 2F FD`
   切帧、逐帧解。第一版没做这件事，标题/工作目录大面积读不出来。

2. **头部解码要「帧数 + 字节」双限。** 帧大小不固定（实测 1.5 KB ~ 35 KB 都有），
   只限帧数会漏后文，只限字节会白解一堆帧。两个都设，取先到的那个；
   并且 magic 也可能出现在压缩数据内部，解不开就跳过，靠 JSON 解析兜住误判。

3. **projcache 有两种布局，都得清。** 实测 `<home>/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json`
   与 `<home>/storages/session_projcache.json` 的 `tables.sessions[<id>]` 同时存在。
   只清一种就会留下悬空条目。

4. **存在「空壳」会话目录。** 真实 `~/.dsh` 里有目录建了但没写成日志的会话
   （实测 15 个会话目录里有 1 个）。如果「必须扫到日志才算会话」，
   这类目录就永远删不掉。改成：**目录名精确等于 sessionId 就认**，
   日志有无只作为 `hasLog` 事实回传。

5. **侧边栏那一行不会自己消失 —— 但有一条现成的事件。**
   客户端 `ctx.sessions`（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller` 的 client 半）
   通过 `ctx.remote.$on('api-session/added' | 'api-session/removed', …)` 维护会话列表；
   宿主侧 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-remotes` 把这批宿主 Cordis 事件原样转发给浏览器。
   所以删完文件只要 `ctx.emit('api-session/removed', sessionId)`，那一行立刻消失，
   不必等下一次 list 刷新，也不必自己去动客户端的列表状态。

6. **删除当前会话受 Windows 文件语义影响。** 宿主对日志文件是**持有句柄持续追加写**的。
   Node/libuv 打开文件时带 `FILE_SHARE_DELETE`，所以删除通常能成功（名字立刻消失），
   但宿主后台仍可能在写那个已经 unlink 的文件。因此确认框里明确写了
   「若它正在运行，建议删完重启一次 DSH」。

7. **`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` 在浏览器里 require 不到。**
   浏览器端模块表里只有两类东西：平台种子词（react 一族）和**声明了 `dsh.client`
   的 Loader 条目**。primitives 两个都不是 —— 它没有 `dsh.client`，在插件树里也没有
   对应条目（实测 201 条 Loader 条目里没有它）；官方客户端插件是在**构建期**把它内联
   进自己 bundle 的。所以第三方插件要么自己上构建，要么自己画。本插件选择自己画，
   但严格照官方 `Menu.module.css` 的规格与主题变量来（见第二节）。
   推论：`dsh.client.inject` 里写一个不存在的包名不会报错（只是解析不到），
   真正会炸的是运行时的 `require` —— 所以本插件只 `require("react")`。

---

## 六、配置

`<DSH_HOME>/hard-delete.config.json`（可选；env 优先）。载入一次常驻，改完**重启 DSH** 生效。

```json
{
  "apiPrefix": "/api/dsh-hard-delete",
  "cleanMetadata": true,
  "emitRemovedEvent": true,
  "maxFiles": 20000,
  "headerFrames": 32,
  "headerScanBytes": 262144,
  "text": {}
}
```

env 覆盖：`DSH_HOME`、`HARD_DELETE_CONFIG`、`HARD_DELETE_API_PREFIX`。

`text` 段可按 key 覆盖界面文案（前端内置 zh 字典兜底；默认下发空表 = 不覆盖）。
`cleanMetadata:false` = 只删会话目录，留元数据；`emitRemovedEvent:false` = 不发那一行消失事件。

---

## 七、测试

```bash
node _test/test-host.mjs           # 39 项夹具断言，全在临时目录里跑，不碰真实会话
node _test/test-client.mjs         # 11 项客户端离线断言（最小 hooks 运行时跑一遍渲染）
node _test/smoke-real-readonly.mjs # 对真实 ~/.dsh 只读冒烟（不做任何写操作）
node _test/verify-e2e-copy.mjs     # 把真实 home 复制一份，走完整 HTTP 栈删一个真会话
```

夹具单测覆盖：多项目定位、版本号文件名、多帧 zstd 头部解码、两种 projcache 布局、
空壳目录、路径穿越、dryRun、workspace.json 引用清理、删除后 404、
loopback / Host / 跨站 / 跨源 / 405 / 非法 JSON / 413 / `confirm` 校验 /
`api-session/removed` 的发出与关闭开关。

客户端离线单测覆盖：factory 形态、**只 require `react`**、两个槽位的 id/order/locale、
文案 key 全部有兜底、菜单项 DOM 与官方同构且点击后关菜单并写入请求、
确认框三条警告齐全且默认焦点在「取消」、缺 slots API 时明确报错、
sessions 服务取不到时降级不炸。

`verify-e2e-copy.mjs` 是最后一道闸：真实会话目录里的多版本日志、真实 projcache
与 workspace.json，走完整链路删掉一个真会话后逐项核对，**真实库全程只读**。

---

## 八、明确不做的事（以及为什么）

- **不做回收站 / 回滚**：本插件就是「删掉」这一个动作。要可恢复请用 `dsh-session-recycle`。
- **不做活动守卫**：用户要的是「自由删除」，加守卫就回到了软删插件的语义。
  取而代之的是确认框里把风险讲清楚（不可恢复 / 当前会话 / 可能仍在写盘）。
- **不改主包的会话列表状态**：只发一个宿主事件，列表由客户端自己维护。
- **不碰宿主服务**：只 `inject: ['webServer']`，不 import 会话/工作区服务。
- **不返回绝对路径**：前端显示不了也不需要。

---

## 九、许可

**AGPL-3.0-only**（GNU Affero General Public License v3.0），全文见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)。

本项目管理在 **AGPL-3.0** 下开放：个人、学习、开源项目可自由使用与修改。
若需在 **闭源** 或 **商业场景** 中使用（不愿承接 AGPL 的传染条款），请联系获取**商业授权** ——
本仓暂无公开的联系邮箱，**请通过本仓 Issue 联系**。

本仓自 v0.1.0 起即为 AGPL-3.0，尚无许可变更历史。

本仓代码为**独立实现**：实现时观察了宿主公开的运行时约定（HTTP 路由注册方式 `ctx.webServer.register`、
客户端打包形态 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load`、槽位注册 `ctx.slots.inject/register`、
磁盘布局与日志文件名、转发事件 allowlist）与官方 `Menu.module.css` 的公开样式规格；
**未复制任何第三方插件代码**。命名上刻意避开 npm 上已被占用的 `dsh-session-delete` / `dsh-session-recycle`。

---

## 十、发布与收录

- 发布流程、版本号策略与推送步骤见 [docs/RELEASING.md](docs/RELEASING.md)；
  推送脚本 [scripts/push-publish.mjs](scripts/push-publish.mjs)（token 只从环境变量读，不落盘、不进 git 配置）。
- **远端只有 GitHub**：插件市场按 GitHub 仓库索引，Gitee 镜像对本仓没有收益，故不做。
- **插件市场收录**：[dshbase](https://dshbase.com/) 与 [DSH 插件市场](https://github.com/bradeGithub/DSH-Plugins-Marketplace)
  按 GitHub 仓库的 **`dsh-plugin` topic 自动索引**（每 2 小时扫一次）。本仓的 topic：
  `dsh-plugin` · `dsh` · `deepseek-harness` · `cordis-plugin`。
- 市场按 `package.json` 的 `version` 判断更新；**发版必须 bump version**（见 CHANGELOG）。

plugins.description: Tavily-backed WebSearchProvider for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (ctx.web) — npm: dsh-tavily-cxykyw
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-tavily-cxykyw

[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md) A [Tavily](https://tavily.com)-backed `WebSearchProvider` for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web capability seam (`ctx.web`). It routes the built-in `web_search` tool to Tavily's dedicated search API instead of the shipped DeepSeek model-based search channel, so **a search costs no model tokens** and the result set comes from a real search engine index rather than an auxiliary model request. Verified against DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`. > Package name note: `dsh-web-search-tavily` on npm belongs to another author. This plugin is published as **`dsh-tavily-cxykyw`**; the GitHub repository is still `cxykyw/dsh-web-search-tavily`. ## What it does - registers a search provider with the stable id **`tavily`** on `ctx.web`; - maps Tavily's response to DSH's normalized `WebSearchResult` — `results[].url/title/content` become `sources[].url/title/snippet`, and Tavily's optional `answer` becomes the result `content`; - resolves the API key on **every** search, in this order: literal `apiKey` → credentials service (`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`) → launch environment / `process.env`; - `available()` is a cheap local check (key + base URL present) with no network calls — a missing key surfaces as `WEB_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_MISSING` at search time; - then truncates to `request.maxResults` through the seam, exactly like any other provider. ## Install ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tavily-cxykyw ``` If your DSH profile is a pnpm workspace root (the default `~/.dsh/profiles/web` is), the add must target the workspace root: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tavily-cxykyw -w ``` The bundled `cordis.patch.yml` declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so adding the package also registers it as a profile bundle: the provider row is inserted **and** `web.searchProvider` is set to `tavily` for you. Restart `dsh web` afterwards — bundle changes are not hot-reloaded. From a checkout instead of npm: ```sh git clone https://github.com/cxykyw/dsh-web-search-tavily.git dsh plugin --profile web add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-web-search-tavily -w ``` ## Configure the API key Get a key at [app.tavily.com](https://app.tavily.com) (there is a free tier). Then pick **one** of: **1. Credentials file (recommended — outside every repository):** ```yaml # ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml TAVILY_API_KEY: tvly-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx ``` **2. Environment variable** of the process that launches DSH: ```sh TAVILY_API_KEY=tvly-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx dsh web ``` **3. Literal key in your own profile patch** (works, but keeps the secret in a plain file — prefer 1 or 2): ```yaml # ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml - id: web-search-tavily config: apiKey: tvly-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx ``` > **Never commit an API key.** This repository, its `cordis.patch.yml`, and its published npm tarball contain **no** credentials and no default key: the plugin only ever reads them from your machine at search time. `.gitignore` also excludes `.env*`, `.npmrc`, and `*.local.yml`. ## Options Configurable on the inserted `web-search-tavily` row: | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `apiKey` | — | Literal Tavily API key. Prefer `apiKeyEnv` + credentials/env. | | `apiKeyEnv` | `TAVILY_API_KEY` | Credential reference / environment variable name to resolve the key from. | | `baseURL` | `https://api.tavily.com` | Tavily API base URL (point it at a proxy if you need one). | | `searchDepth` | `basic` | `basic` (fast, 1 credit) or `advanced` (deeper crawl, more credits). | | `maxResults` | `8` | Results requested per search, 1–20. A per-call `maxResults` still wins. | Example, overriding just the depth and result count: ```yaml # ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml - id: web-search-tavily config: searchDepth: advanced maxResults: 5 ``` ## Switching providers The bundle patch already pins the seam: ```yaml - id: web config: searchProvider: tavily fetchProvider: http ``` To fall back to the official DeepSeek search, set `searchProvider: deepseek-official` (or remove the line only if `deepseek-official` is the single usable provider — with two usable providers and no pin, the seam fails closed with `WEB_PROVIDER_AMBIGUOUS`). > Upgrading from a hand-inserted copy in your own profile patch? Delete that `insert` block and keep only the `- id: web-search-tavily` config override above, otherwise the row id is inserted twice. ## Notes and limitations - No Web settings page: DSH `0.2` cannot mount this plugin's settings section, so the provider is configured through the profile patch only. - `fetch` (page retrieval) is untouched — it stays on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http`. - Tavily search results carry no publication date, so `sources[].publishedAt` is not set. ## Uninstall ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-tavily-cxykyw -w ``` ## License MIT © cxykyw

plugins.description: 深鲸画布 · DSH 插件：把一段文字变成能发的视频。稿子、素材、成片都在你自己的电脑上，不上传、不联网。免费版可用。
plugins.readme_text:
# 深鲸画布 · DSH 插件

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/feely0208/dsh-shell-canvas)

把一段文字，变成能发的视频。

贴一段稿子、选几张素材，点一下出横竖双版成片。
**稿子、素材、成片都在你自己的电脑上** —— 不上传、不联网，拔掉网线照样出片。

## 安装

在你所用的、支持 DSH 的载体里打开「插件管理器」，选择**从压缩包安装**，选中下载好的 `.tgz` 即可。

命令行安装：

```bash
# 推荐：从 npm 装（始终取最新版，不钉版本号）
dsh plugin add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-shell-canvas
```

也可以从官网下载插件包后，在插件管理器里「从压缩包安装」：
<https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/download.html>


装完无需重启，界面跟随所在载体的外观。

## 能力

- **一次出三种版式** —— 旁白口播 / 金句引用 / 步骤清单，编排各不相同
- **逐句指定配图** —— 分镜表里逐句安排素材与时长，素材与字幕一一对应
- **一个位置放多张图或一段视频** —— 多图按时间轮播；视频素材会让画面真的动起来
- **每个镜头换版位** —— 尺寸、位置、入场方式逐镜轮换
- **一次出横竖双版** —— 同一份稿子，横版竖版一起给
- **模型不绑任何一家** —— 生图与配音接你自己的接口，密钥留在本机
- **批量出片** —— 一次丢进一整批；一条出错不拖垮整批
- **跨平台** —— macOS / Windows / Linux

## 授权

| | |
|---|---|
| **免费版** | **不限条数**出片，成片带水印，直接下载就能用，不用注册 |
| **授权版** | ¥199/年，去掉水印 + 批量出片 + 每条可查 |

有效期 1 年，期间不限出片次数。授权码按时间到期，**不绑机器**。

## 平台

装在任意支持 DSH 的载体上，**不绑定桌面端**。

plugins.description: Sign in to ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot and other subscription model routes inside the DeepSeek Harness — the sign-in button the Harness never shipped.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-subscription-signin

[![tests](https://github.com/amosogra/dsh-subscription-signin/actions/workflows/tests.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/amosogra/dsh-subscription-signin/actions/workflows/tests.yml)

**The sign-in button the DeepSeek Harness never shipped.**

Use the AI subscriptions you already pay for — ChatGPT Plus/Pro, Claude Pro/Max,
GitHub Copilot, and more — as model routes inside the
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Adds a
**Subscriptions** settings page plus a compact extension on every provider card
in **Settings → Models**.

```text
Settings → Subscriptions → ChatGPT (Codex) → [ Sign in with ChatGPT (Codex) ]
                                    ↓
                    github.com/login/device  ·  code ABCD-1234
                                    ↓
                    ✓ Signed in — draws on your plan
```

No password is ever collected or stored by this plugin. The vendor runs the
sign-in on its own page; the Harness credential store writes the token.

## Repository layout

The **installable package is the `dsh-subscription-signin/` directory.** The
tests, license and documentation sit beside it and are not part of the package:

```text
dsh-subscription-signin/   ← the package; this is what you install
  host.js                  ← the Host half (tool + HTTP route)
  client.js                ← the Client half (settings page + provider card)
  cordis.patch.yml         ← the accounts, as configuration
  locale/en.json           ← package metadata strings
  package.json
smoketest/                 ← five dependency-free suites (run from the root)
docs/FINDINGS.md           ← what was measured vs inferred
```

---

## Why this exists

The Harness already ships everything needed to *use* a subscription as a model
route. Its LLM adapter registers OAuth flows for eight providers — the transport
works, the token exchange works, the credential store works.

What it has no surface for is **starting** one. Nothing in the GUI or CLI ever
calls the authorization seam's `begin()`. This plugin is that missing surface.

It implements **no OAuth**. It does not touch PKCE, state, device codes, or token
parsing — all of that lives in `@earendil-works/pi-ai`, shipped by DeepSeek. This
plugin asks the Harness to begin a flow, shows you the URL and code, and reports
the result.

## Supported providers

Configured out of the box, driven through the Harness's own authorization seam:

| Provider | Credential | Login style |
|---|---|---|
| ChatGPT (Codex) | `llm-pi-ai/openai-codex` | device code |
| Claude (Pro/Max) | `llm-pi-ai/anthropic` | OAuth |
| GitHub Copilot | `llm-pi-ai/github-copilot` | device code |
| xAI | `llm-pi-ai/xai` | device code |
| Meta | `llm-pi-ai/meta` | device code |
| OpenRouter | `llm-pi-ai/openrouter` | OAuth + paste fallback |
| Radius | `llm-pi-ai/radius` | browser callback |
| Kimi For Coding | `llm-pi-ai/kimi-coding` | device code |

**Honest status.** Sign-in is verified end to end for **ChatGPT (Codex)** and
**Claude (Pro/Max)**; Claude's route was observed authenticating successfully and
then being rate-limited by the account (HTTP 429 with Anthropic's own
`request_id` — a quota answer, not a credential failure). Copilot's flow is
verified and completes. xAI, Meta, OpenRouter, Radius and Kimi hold credentials
that have been written successfully, but **no request has been served on those
routes in the session where this was verified**, so treat them as untested rather
than broken. `docs/FINDINGS.md` records what is measured versus inferred.

## Install

**Requirements.** DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` or later. Developed and verified
against `0.2.0-rc.2`, the release this plugin's two seams were checked on
(`ctx.authorization` from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-authorization`, and the client
`slots` service). Every Harness service it consumes is reached with a defensive
`ctx.get(...)` plus an undefined check, so a missing one degrades to a reported
message instead of a crash — but a Harness that has moved a seam will still need
a matching plugin release.

The plugin is installed into a Harness **profile** as a bundle. Point the plugin
manager at this directory:

```text
install_bundle: link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-subscription-signin
```

Or, if you publish/consume it as a package, install by name and add it to your
profile's bundle list:

```jsonc
// $DSH_PROFILE_DIR/package.json
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "dsh-subscription-signin"] } }
```

Then **restart DSH once.** This matters and is explained under
[Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting) — the client half is composed into the
browser's boot graph at startup, so a freshly installed bundle has no page until
the process restarts.

## Use

From the GUI: **Settings → Subscriptions**, pick an account, press *Sign in*.

For an agent, or a headless harness, the same implementation is exposed as a tool
with actions `status`, `start`, `poll`, `cancel`, `signout`, `submitCode` and
`diagnostics`. Read `status` first; `start` returns the URL and, for device
grants, the code you enter on the vendor's page.

## Safety

This section is the reason to trust the plugin, so it is specific rather than
reassuring.

**It never sees a secret.** No password, token, API key or refresh token is read,
written, logged, or forwarded. The token is produced and stored by the Harness
credential seam (`ctx.authorization` / `ctx.credentials`), not by this code.
Audit it yourself — it is two files:

- **`host.js`** — zero imports. No filesystem access, no network requests, no
  child processes. It asks the credential store *whether* a record exists, and
  can delete one on explicit `signout` with `confirm: true`; it never reads a
  token value. The one `process.env` write is the documented per-account `env`
  field (used so a provider that selects its endpoint from the environment can be
  configured per account), and it is restored when the attempt settles.
- **`client.js`** — one dependency, `react`, supplied by the page. Its only
  `fetch` calls go to the plugin's own `/plugins/subscription-signin` route on
  your local Harness. Nothing is rendered from a credential.

**The one network-bearing route is trust-gated.** The panel reaches the Host half
over an HTTP route that inherits the Harness's own checks
(`connection.requestRejection`: Host/Origin validation and browser
authentication). On top of that, every mutating call must be a JSON `POST`, which
forces a CORS preflight and blocks form-based CSRF; bodies are capped at 64 KiB;
responses are `no-store` + `nosniff`.

**Not sanctioned by the vendors — read this.** For ChatGPT-plan usage, the
Harness targets the ChatGPT/Codex backend
(`chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex`), which OpenAI's developer documentation tells
third-party apps not to target for plan usage. **This plugin surfaces behaviour
the Harness already ships; it does not introduce it and cannot change it.** The
sanctioned path for third-party apps is *Sign in with ChatGPT*, which the Harness
does not implement. Using a subscription outside a vendor's intended client may
conflict with that vendor's terms, and vendors may rate-limit or block such
traffic. You are choosing to do that with your own account. Do not use this to
resell access, and do not use it to reach credentials that are not yours.

**No credentials are in this repository.** If you ever find one here, that is a
bug — please open an issue. The repository was scanned for tokens, private keys,
home paths and email addresses before its first commit. `docs/FINDINGS.md` does
cite exact package versions and source symbols from the Harness, which is
deliberate: a claim about a specific build is only useful if it names the build.

**Found a vulnerability?** Report it privately via
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) rather than a public issue. That file also lists what
is and is not in scope — worth reading first, because the unofficial-backend
caveat above is a documented trade-off rather than a defect, and the two are easy
to confuse.

## Configuration

Accounts are configured, not hardcoded. They live in this package's own
[`cordis.patch.yml`](dsh-subscripti

plugins.description: DSH skill: inline version stamps for text artifacts, plus a drift check that works as a CI gate
plugins.readme_text:
> 🕒 v2 · 2026-10-10 08:52 · dsh-agent ｜ 变更：加实测演示图（docs/demo.png） ｜ 上一版：v1 · 2026-10-10 08:50

# dsh-artifact-stamp

给**文本产物**盖「时间戳 + 版本号」的**行内版本戳**，并提供一个可当 CI 关卡用的体检命令。

一句话：**给文档做一版手工简化的 git** —— 但戳写在文件**自己身上**，人眼一眼可见，机器也能解析。

## 为什么会有这个

当 agent 频繁改写 `.md`（笔记、技能、README、实验记录）时，会遇到一个问题：

- **git 不适合**：文档是持续追加的，每次改动都 commit 太重；而且看历史要跳出文件本身
- **不管也不行**：你打开一个文档，**不知道它什么时候写的、这一版改了什么、上一版长什么样**

所以约定一条：**每个文本产物的正文最前面，有一行可读、可解析的戳**。

```
> 🕒 v2 · 2026-10-10 08:50 · dsh-agent ｜ 变更：补实验结论 ｜ 上一版：v1 · 2026-10-10 08:48
```

> 🔴 **没有脚本守的约定一定会漂移。** 所以这条约定配了工具 + 体检命令：
> `check` 会比对「戳里的时间」与「文件 mtime」，**改过却没盖戳 → 退出码 1**。

## 装

本仓库根目录就是一个 **DSH 技能**，clone 后放进用户级技能根即可：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/yanggaihao5-sys/dsh-artifact-stamp.git
cp -r dsh-artifact-stamp ~/.dsh/skills/artifact-stamp
```

Windows（PowerShell）：

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/yanggaihao5-sys/dsh-artifact-stamp.git
Copy-Item -Recurse dsh-artifact-stamp "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\skills\artifact-stamp"
```

只用命令行也行（**纯标准库、无网络、可离线跑**）：

```bash
python scripts/artifact_stamp.py new  <file> --note "初稿"
python scripts/artifact_stamp.py bump <file> --note "补数据"
python scripts/artifact_stamp.py show <file>
python scripts/artifact_stamp.py check <路径...> [--days 30] [--include-code]
python scripts/artifact_stamp.py strip <路径...> --dry-run
```

| 子命令 | 干什么 |
|---|---|
| `new` | 新建时盖 v1（已有戳则不覆盖） |
| `bump` | 改完后升版 v1→v2；**note 没变就不升版**（除非 `--force`） |
| `show` | 看当前戳 |
| `check` | 体检：缺戳 / **改过没盖戳** / 戳过期；**退出码 1 = 有违规** |
| `strip` | 回滚：一键删掉所有戳行（`--dry-run` 先预览） |

## 实测演示

![实测输出](docs/demo.png)

> 上图是 `demo/` 里**真实跑出来的输出**的排版图（不是终端截屏；emoji 以文字替代）。

```
$ python scripts/artifact_stamp.py new demo/design.md --note "初稿：设计笔记"
stamped v1: demo/design.md

# 过了 95 秒后改了内容，但忘了盖戳：
$ python scripts/artifact_stamp.py check demo
  ✗ 改过没盖戳：文件 mtime=2026-10-10 08:50，戳=2026-10-10 08:48（v1）
      demo/design.md

统计：文本文件 1 · 有戳 1 · 缺戳 0 · 改过没盖戳 1 · 戳超过 30 天 0 · 非UTF8跳过 0 · PS无BOM 0
判定：有违规（退出码 1）。修复：`artifact_stamp.py new <file>` 或 `bump <file> --note "..."`

$ python scripts/artifact_stamp.py bump demo/design.md --note "补实验结论"
bumped: demo/design.md -> v2 @ 2026-10-10 08:50

$ python scripts/artifact_stamp.py check demo
```

盖完的正文长这样：

```

# 设计笔记

第一版。

补了一段实验结论。
```

## 支持哪些文件类型

戳必须写成该文件类型合法的注释，否则会把源码写坏。已内建映射：

| 扩展名 | 前缀 |
|---|---|
| `.md` `.markdown` `.txt` `.rst` `.org` | `> ` |
| `.py` `.ps1` `.sh` `.yaml` `.toml` `.ini` `.r` `.jl` `.m` … | `# ` |
| `.js` `.ts` `.c` `.cpp` `.java` `.go` `.rs` … | `// ` |
| `.tex` `.bib` `.sty` `.cls` | `% ` |
| `.vbs` `.vba` `.bas` | `' ` |

**不认识的类型直接拒绝盖戳并报错**（而不是硬插一行把文件弄坏）。

## 🔴 已知限制（先说清楚）

1. **90 秒分辨率**：戳只有**分钟精度**，而 mtime 是秒精度。所以**盖戳后 90 秒内的改动 `check` 检测不到**（默认 `--tolerance 90` 就是为了吸收这个偏差）。
   ⚠️ **`--tolerance 0` 不是可用设置**——它会对每个刚盖过戳的文件都报漂移。想要更灵敏只能把戳精度改成秒。
2. **不是 git 的替代品**：它只记「**什么时候、改了什么（一句话）**」，**不存差异、不能回滚内容**。真正的版本控制仍然用 git。
3. **不改文件编码**：原文件带 UTF-8 BOM 就保留，没有就不加。**唯一例外**是给 `.ps1` 写进非 ASCII 时会自动补 BOM（Windows PowerShell 5.1 会把无 BOM 的脚本按 GBK 读 → 中文乱码/语法错）。
4. **保护 YAML frontmatter**：`SKILL.md` 这类带 `---` 头的文件，戳插在 frontmatter **之后**。
5. **保护 shebang**：`.py` 的 `#!` 与 PEP-263 编码行永远留在最前（早期版本曾把戳插到第 1 行，导致 `./x.py` 直接执行失效）。
6. **体检默认跳过** `.git` / `node_modules` / `__pycache__` / `backups` / `_归档`；默认不检查 `.json`（数据文件不该盖戳）。

## License

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: fixes dsh-ui table cells painting text over the next column, and wraps long cells instead of forcing a horizontal scrollbar.
plugins.readme_text:
# @adamcjm/dsh-genui-bugfix

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh) plugin that repairs `dsh-ui` table rendering:

- **cells no longer paint their text over the next column** — the bug where a long run of inline-code chips bleeds across the column boundary;
- **long cells wrap** instead of stretching the table until it needs a horizontal scrollbar.

It applies to the shipped `@changfenhuang/dsh-genui` **0.11.x** and does not wait for an upstream release. Once upstream ships its own fix, this plugin stays harmless and can simply be removed.

## What it fixes

`dsh-ui` table cells default to `white-space: nowrap` (the plugin's deliberate "data columns do not fold" voice). Meanwhile the host shell renders message bodies inside a `.markdown` subtree, and two rules from that sheet land on `dsh-ui` output because the components render in the same subtree:

```css
.markdown { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }                 /* inherited by every cell */
.markdown :not(pre) > code { display: inline-flex; }   /* every chip becomes an atomic inline box */
```

Add the plugin's own `.inlineCode { white-space: pre-wrap }` and the chip's **automatic minimum size collapses**: the column may be sized below its own content, while the cell's `nowrap` still paints the text unbroken — straight over the neighbouring column.

Only cells containing inline code are affected. A pure-text cell is `nowrap`, so its min-content already equals its content width and the column can never be sized below it.

Measured on a live DSH desktop page (7 tables): on 0.11.4, 4 tables and 12 cells overflowed, the worst single cell by **704px**.

## The two rules it injects

```css
/* 1) Table chips must not re-open line breaking — this is the root cause. */
[class*="tableWrap"] table [class*="inlineCode"] { white-space: pre !important; }

/* 2) Single-line data cells wrap — long content no longer stretches the table. */
[class*="tableWrap"] table td:not([class*="tdMultiline"]):not([class*="tdCode"]),
[class*="tableWrap"] table th:not([class*="tdMultiline"]):not([class*="tdCode"]) {
  white-space: normal !important;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
```

The selectors use only **CSS Modules class-name prefixes** (`tableWrap`, `inlineCode`, `tdMultiline`, `tdCode`), never the build-time hash, so they survive plugin upgrades.

Rule 2 is a **preference**. Remove that block from `lib/client.js` if you would rather keep the upstream behaviour of a wider table plus horizontal scrolling.

## Geometry verification

The same browser fixture, in an 801px container:

| Styles | Table width | Horizontal scroll | Cross-column bleed |
|---|---|---|---|
| upstream 0.11.4 (unfixed) | 1471px | yes | **4 cells, worst 306px** |
| upstream `main` (fix #282) | 1777px | yes | none |
| **this plugin** | **799px** | **no** | **none** |

In other words: the upstream repair makes the table wider and asks you to scroll; this plugin lets the long content wrap, so the table fits the conversation column.

## Install

The plugin is an ordinary DSH bundle: a dependency in a profile, plus one entry in that profile's bundle list.

### From npm

1. Add it to the profile you want it in — `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json`:

   ```json
   {
     "dependencies": {
       "@adamcjm/dsh-genui-bugfix": "^0.1.0"
     },
     "dsh": {
       "profile": {
         "bundles": ["…", "@adamcjm/dsh-genui-bugfix"]
       }
     }
   }
   ```

2. Install it:

   ```
   cd ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile> && pnpm install
   ```

3. **Restart the DSH app.** The host-side plugin tree is assembled when the process starts, so a running instance will not pick up a new bundle.

If pnpm refuses the freshly published version because of a minimum-release-age policy, add the package name to `minimumReleaseAgeExclude` in that profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`.

### From a local checkout

Use a `link:` path instead of the version, for example `"@adamcjm/dsh-genui-bugfix": "link:/path/to/dsh-genui-bugfix"`, then run the same two steps.

## Verify

After a restart the renderer carries one extra stylesheet:

```js
document.getElementById('dsh-genui-bugfix/table-overflow')   // non-null once loaded
```

Visually: tables with long inline-code runs no longer print text over the next column, and their width matches the conversation column instead of scrolling.

Without DSH running you can still check both halves against the loader contract:

```
cd <plugin> && npm test
```

## Uninstall

1. Remove `@adamcjm/dsh-genui-bugfix` from the profile's `dependencies` and `bundles`;
2. `pnpm install`;
3. restart DSH.

## Relation to the upstream fix

- Upstream `main` already fixes the overlap itself (PR [#282](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-genui/pull/282), not yet released). Rule 1 here has the same effect and coexists with it — both keep the chip at `white-space: pre`.
- The upstream browser fixture cannot catch that regression: its cross-column assertion is vacuously true because the fixture renders tables outside the host `.markdown` cascade. See issue [#285](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-genui/issues/285) and PR [#286](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-genui/pull/286).

## Layout

```
@adamcjm/dsh-genui-bugfix/
├── package.json        # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client declarations
├── cordis.patch.yml    # inserts one plugin row into the profile
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js        # host half: node ESM, exports name/apply/inject, no behaviour
│   └── client.js       # browser half: window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })
├── test/verify.mjs     # zero-dependency self-check of the loader contract
└── README.md
```

Both halves follow the shapes already used by shipped plugins:

- the **host** half is plain node ESM exporting `name` / `apply` / `inject` — the same shape as the host half of `dsh-window-drag-probe`, which also has no host-side behaviour;
- the **client** half must be the pre-bundled form DSH serves to the renderer, `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`, where `factory` returns the exports carrying `apply` — the same shape as the client artifacts of `@changfenhuang/dsh-genui` and `dsh-boot-animation`. A plain ESM `export function apply` is **not** loaded, and it fails silently rather than reporting an error. This plugin has no runtime dependencies, so its factory never needs `require`.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin that presses "continue" for you: when a turn ends by exhausting the output-token limit it sends a next-turn follow-up automatically, gated by a per-session burst cap, a minimum interval, and an opt-out.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-continue-on-limit

**模型写到输出上限被截断时，插件替你按「继续」。**

**简体中文** | [English](./README.en.md)

DeepSeek Harness 宿主侧插件：监听 `turn/end` 的 `max-tokens` 结束原因，通过
`agent.followup()` 发一条普通的下一个 turn 提示词，并受每会话 burst 上限、
最小间隔和总开关约束。没有客户端半部，不碰 React slot，不依赖任何 UI 快照字段。

> **English.** A host-side DeepSeek Harness plugin that presses "continue" for you
> when the model stops because it exhausted its output-token budget. It watches
> `turn/end` for `reason.kind === 'max-tokens'` and issues an ordinary next-turn
> follow-up through `agent.followup()`, gated by a per-session burst cap, a
> minimum interval, and an opt-out. No client half, no UI snapshot dependency,
> 61 tests on bare `node`.

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-continue-on-limit)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-continue-on-limit)
![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)
![tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-61%20passing-brightgreen)
![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22-informational)

---

## 目录

- [它解决什么](#它解决什么)
- [安装](#安装)
- [配置](#配置)
- [工作原理](#工作原理)
  - [1. 检测：只听宿主侧事件](#1-检测只听宿主侧事件)
  - [2. 发送时机：为什么不能直接在回调里发](#2-发送时机为什么不能直接在回调里发)
  - [3. 消息身份：为什么不用 user](#3-消息身份为什么不用-user)
- [安全设计](#安全设计)
- [测试](#测试)
- [已知限制](#已知限制)
- [与 harness 原生的关系](#与-harness-原生的关系)
- [故障排查](#故障排查)
- [开发](#开发)
- [License](#license)

## 它解决什么

dsh 原生**不会**自动续写。一个 turn 以 `max-tokens` 结束时，harness 把会话停住，
UI 显示「回答被截断…发送"继续"可让模型接着输出」。这是有意设计——等人来决定要不要
接着写。

如果你嫌每次截断都要手打两个字，这个插件就是把那两个字自动化。

自动续写**不冒充人类输入**：它以插件身份进入对话，在聊天界面渲染成一条
「插件状态更新」，写明是哪条通知触发了这一轮。一条链完整可审计。

## 安装

本插件是一个标准的 dsh bundle，通过 profile 的 `package.json` 挂载。

### 从 npm 安装

在 profile 的 `package.json`（`~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/package.json`）里加依赖，并加进
`bundles`：

```jsonc
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-plugin-continue-on-limit": "^0.1.0"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app",
        "dsh-plugin-continue-on-limit"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

然后在 profile 目录里装依赖，重启 dsh：

```bash
pnpm install
```

`cordis.patch.yml` 会通过 `dsh.bundle.patch` 自动挂进 patch 列表，不需要手写那条
`- insert:`。

### 从源码安装

只有要改插件本身时才需要。先 clone 并装好它自己的依赖：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/aqiu817/dsh-plugin-continue-on-limit.git
cd dsh-plugin-continue-on-limit
npm install --ignore-scripts
```

用 npm 而非 pnpm：pnpm 在部分沙箱环境下建不出 junction，会把顶层 `node_modules`
落成实体目录，导致 `@deepseek-ai/cosmokit` 不可达。

再把 profile 的依赖指向本地路径：

```jsonc
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-plugin-continue-on-limit": "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-plugin-continue-on-limit"
  }
}
```

`pnpm install`，重启 dsh。

### 卸载

删掉依赖和 `bundles` 里那一行，再 `pnpm install`。没有残留状态。

> 本插件**不是** `required` bundle：组合失败不会写启动日志。装完请确认 Plugins
> 页面能看到 `continue-on-limit` 这一项。

## 配置

三个字段全部是 `.volatile()`：在 Plugins 页面改了**不重载 fiber**，
`enabled: false` 中途就能掐断一条正在跑的链。

| 字段 | 类型 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | `true` | 总开关 |
| `continueText` | string (1–200) | `继续` | 发什么文字 |
| `maxConsecutive` | integer (0–16) | `3` | 单会话一条截断链最多自动续写几次；`0` = 无上限 |
| `minIntervalMs` | integer (0–600000) | `1500` | 两次续写的最小间隔，防死循环 |

`cordis.patch.yml` 里的默认值：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: continue-on-limit
      name: 'dsh-plugin-continue-on-limit'
      config:
        enabled: true
        continueText: '继续'
        maxConsecutive: 3
        minIntervalMs: 1500
```

## 工作原理

### 1. 检测：只听宿主侧事件

宿主侧单一数据源，和 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-goal-round-driver` 用的是同一条路：

```js
ctx.on('session/event', (session, event) => {
  if (event.type !== 'turn/end') return;
  const agent = ctx.agents.get(session.id);
  if (agent === void 0 || agent.session !== session) return;
  if (event.data.reason.kind !== 'max-tokens') return;
  // ...
});
```

`turn/end` 的 payload 就是 `{ turn, reason }`，`reason` 是 `TurnEndReason`，
截断标记直接可读。

**刻意没有用的两条路：**

- `agent/turn-stopping`——payload 是 `{ agent, turn, signal }`，**没有 reason**，
  拿不到截断信息，只能盲发。
- 客户端 `SessionSnapshot`——字段是固定的 14 个，其中**没有** `queue`、`pending`、
  `nodes`（真实字段叫 `pendingSubmissions`）。按名字猜字段会在每次快照更新时抛
  `TypeError`；即便加了 `?.`，候选集也永远是空集，检测分支永远进不去——
  表现为「装得上、起得来、功能不触发」。

### 2. 发送时机：为什么不能直接在回调里发

`turn/end` 是从 `Session.append` **内部**广播出来的，而 `append` 在广播期间把重入
闸门打开：

```js
if (entry?.appending) throw new Error("session append cannot reenter while another append is being published");
// ...callbacks 同步运行...
finally { entry.appending = false; }   // 回调返回后才复位
```

`Agent.followup()` 本身就要 append（它得写一条 inbox splice 记录），所以从回调里
**同步**调用必然抛错：

```text
Error: session append cannot reenter while another append is being published
    at Session.append        (dsh-session)
    at ReactLoopInbox.mutate (dsh-agent-loop)
    at ReactLoopInbox.splice
```

所以发送推迟到 agent 真正 idle 之后：

```js
state.pending = true;
void sendContinuation(...);   // 内部 await agent.whenIdle() 之后才 followup
```

**为什么必须等 idle，而不是随便推迟一个 microtask？** 因为 `wakeDriver()` 只在
`phase.kind === 'idle'` 时才启动新驱动：

```js
wakeDriver(wakeAfterAbort = false) {
  if (this.phase.kind !== "idle") { /* 只有 maintenance / abort 才记 wakeRequested */ return; }
  this.setPhase({ kind: "running", ... });   // 真正开下一轮
}
```

而驱动循环在 `append("turn/end")` 之后立刻检查
`if (!this.inbox.hasPending) return false`。消息若晚于这个检查才进 inbox，驱动已经
收工，此时 `wakeDriver` 在 `running` 状态下**不会**记 `wakeRequested`，消息就躺在
inbox 里没人处理。`await agent.whenIdle()` 之后 phase 必为 `idle`，`followup()`
才会真正开出下一轮。

`state.pending` 补的就是这段窗口：发送被推迟期间 `lastTurn` 还没写，第二个
`turn/end` 会重复调度，`pending` 是那道预留，发送落定后清除。

### 3. 消息身份：为什么不用 user

`Agent.followup()` 在调用方不传 `source` 时会自己盖一个 `{ kind: 'user' }`，
而 harness 把 `user` 当作**人的授权**。自动续写冒充人，approval / ask-user
这类流程会误以为真有人在场。

所以插件发的消息 `source.kind` 是 `cordis-host-runner`——harness 在
`MessageSourceMap` 里给宿主侧自动行为预留的 source 类型：

```ts
'cordis-host-runner': { kind: 'cordis-host-runner'; };
```

聊天界面会以「插件触发」的样式渲染。一条链完整可审计。

消息本体是本地构造的，没有 import `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`：
`createUserMessage()` 就是 `createMessage({ ...input, role: 'user' })`，而
`brandString()` 在运行时是恒等函数（文档明确写了 branded id 无 tag、无 prototype、
无 registry），所以本地铸造的 id 完全等价。这样插件的依赖表里只剩 schema 一个，
整包可以用裸 `node --test` 跑，不需要启动 harness、不需要 mock 快照。

## 安全设计

### 三道闸

`maxConsecutive` 是主闸。`3` 是刻意的默认值：够写完一个长回答，又不至于让一个反复
溢出的模型一路烧到上下文塞满。`0` 是显式的「无上限」，属于危险选项。

`minIntervalMs` 是死循环兜底，不是节奏控制——真实模型回复本来就比它慢得多。

### 隐式保护

- inbox 里已有用户排队消息时，**让用户的先跑**（`nextTurn` / `nextStep` 非空即跳过）
- 同一个 turn 不重复续写；发送排队期间（`pending`）也不重复调度
- 非 `max-tokens` 的 turn end 一律不动，且会重置 burst 计数
- `followup()` 抛错只写日志，不往 `session/event` 回调里冒泡；发送本身推迟到
  agent idle 之后（见上文）

### 配置值不会被敲错一个数就失控

`.volatile()` 字段是从 Plugins 页面**直接写进 reference cell** 的，不走加载器的
`Config` 校验。也就是说 schema 只守住了初始组合那一次，运行期改值无人把关。

如果不加防护，在设置页把 `maxConsecutive` 敲成 `-1` 就能让它失效：
`decide()` 里 `if (maxConsecutive > 0 && ...)` 直接短路，**上限静默变成无限制**。
`minIntervalMs: -1` 同理让冷却失效。

所以 `readSettings()` 对每个字段做了类型检查 + 钳制（`LIMITS` 和 schema 共用同一份
边界常量）：

| 输入 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `maxConsecutive: -1` / `99` / `2.5` / `'lots'` | 回落到默认 `3` |
| `maxConsecutive: 0` | 保留 `0`（显式的"无上限"是刻意选项） |
| `minIntervalMs: -50` / `7000000` | 回落到默认 `1500` |
| `continueText: 42` / `'   '` | 回落到默认 `'继续'` |
| `continueText: 'x'.repeat(400)` | 截到 200 |
| `continueText: '  trim me  '` | 去空白 → `'trim me'` |
| `enabled: 'nope'` | 回落到默认 `true` |

关键点是**负数回落到默认值，而不是回落到 `0`**。`0` 是"关掉这道闸"，一个误输的
负数不该有这个权力。

## 测试

```bash
npm test
# tests 61, pass 61, fail 0
```

61 个用例分三层：

| 文件 | 用例 | 覆盖 |
|---|---|---|
| `test/policy.test.mjs` | 17 | 纯决策逻辑，直接喂普通对象，**不 import 任何 Cordis**。burst 上限、冷却、同 turn 去重、非截断 reason、disabled 不改状态…… |
| `test/index.test.mjs` | 28 | 用 mock ctx 驱动真实的 `apply()`，断言 `agent.followup()` 收到的消息形状、冻结性、日志路径、异常边界、session 回收，以及**重入约束**（mock 在 dispatch 窗口内让 `followup` 抛错，断言窗口内零发送、idle 后恰好一次） |
| `test/contract.test.mjs` | 16 | **加载契约**，不测行为，只测"装上会不会炸"。复刻加载器 `jc()` 的逐字逻辑 |

`contract.test.mjs` 断言的具体内容：module graph 能解析、`name` / `inject` /
`Config` / `apply` 都在且类型对、`validate(undefined)` 与 `validate({})` 都不报
`issues`、返回值不是 promise、`Config["~standard"]` 存在、`package.json` 的
`main` / `dsh.bundle.patch` / `files` 全指向真实文件、依赖目录真实可读，以及
import + compose 循环 25 次都稳定。

> `test` 脚本带 `--test-isolation=none`，因为 DSH 的文件沙箱禁止
> `child_process.spawn`，而 `node --test` 默认要给每个测试文件起子进程。
> 在普通环境里用 `node --test` 也能跑。

## 已知限制

- **只认 `max-tokens`。** `aborted` / `error` / `blocked` / `interrupt

# dsh-backdoor-guard

English | [日本語](#日本語)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) plugin that stops **trained-in backdoor payloads** — model weights (e.g. a malicious QLoRa merge) that fire a specific tool call or credential exfiltration when a hidden trigger appears — **before the tool executes**.

Every model-requested tool call is priced by a dedicated **decision model** ([Jev](https://docs.typesafe.ai) hosted, or a self-hosted [LiquidAI d1](https://huggingface.co/LiquidAI/d1-3B) via the bundled shim — both speak the same Decision Index `systemone` schema). Calls judged unsafe are denied at `tools/pre-execute` and a `SECURITY NOTICE` lands in the transcript.

No fork, no logprobs, no regex rules to maintain: one public plugin seam + one judgment call (~100 ms hosted, ~30 ms local d1 on Apple silicon).

## Why a decision model, not the agent's own LLM

- A backdoored model cannot be trusted to police itself; the judge is a **different, tiny, frozen** model.
- Decision models return a **calibrated probability** in one forward pass (zero output tokens) — fast enough to screen every tool call.
- Jev/d1 are built for exactly this: "yes/no with a probability" over a state document (routing, moderation, guardrails).

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-backdoor-guard                 # npm, once published
dsh plugin add github:miketako3/dsh-backdoor-guard # from GitHub
dsh plugin add file:/path/to/dsh-backdoor-guard    # local checkout
```

The package ships a `dsh.bundle` layer, so `plugin add` wires the plugin row automatically.

## Choose the judge

### Option A: hosted Jev (TypeSafe AI)

```sh
export TYPESAFE_API_KEY=ts_...   # from https://console.typesafe.ai
```

```yaml
# profile cordis.patch.yml
- id: backdoor-guard
  name: 'dsh-backdoor-guard'
  config:
    endpoint: https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone
    model: jev-latest
    apiKeyEnv: TYPESAFE_API_KEY
```

### Option B: local d1-3B (LiquidAI, open weights)

```sh
pip install "transformers>=5.14" torch torchvision pillow
python3 server/d1-server.py --model LiquidAI/d1-3B --port 8400
```

```yaml
- id: backdoor-guard
  name: 'dsh-backdoor-guard'
  config:
    endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:8400/v1/systemone
    model: d1-3B
    apiKeyEnv: ''        # empty = no Authorization header (local, unauthenticated)
```

d1-3B is ~30 ms/decision on Apple M5 Pro, ~8 ms on RTX 4090, and reads 32k-token states — whole tool-call payloads fit comfortably. d1-omni-600M works too (text+audio; experimental).

## How a call is judged

The judge receives a state document: the user's latest request, whether the agent visibly announced its action (silent invocations are the runtime signature of a memorized payload), the tool name, canonicalized arguments, and the turn's earlier calls. One Noul question prices legitimacy:

> safe = the call serves the user's stated request; does not read/transmit unrelated credentials or secrets; no obfuscated / pipe-to-shell / self-decoding payloads; no unusual external endpoints; nothing that looks like a hidden-trigger action.

`safe_probability >= threshold` → the call proceeds. Below → deny before dispatch, with the probability in the deny reason.

## Config reference

| key | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `endpoint` | `https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone` | systemone-compatible judge endpoint |
| `model` | `jev-latest` | judge model id |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | env var with the API key; `''` = no auth (local) |
| `threshold` | `0.5` | deny when safe probability falls below |
| `timeoutMs` | `8000` | judge call timeout |
| `skipTools` | `[]` | `*`-wildcard tool names never judged (e.g. `['read', 'web_*']`) |
| `maxArgsChars` | `2000` | argument cap shown to the judge |
| `maxRequestChars` | `1000` | user-request cap shown to the judge |
| `onJudgeError` | `allow` | `allow` = log + proceed when the judge is down; `deny` = fail closed |

Set `onJudgeError: deny` for high-security deployments; keep `allow` while tuning.

## Threat model & limits

- Targets **weight-borne backdoors that act through tools** and **credential exfiltration**; pure text misbehavior is out of scope.
- The judge itself is trusted infrastructure: pin it (local d1 or your own Jev key), and do not route it through the model under review.
- Pair with network egress control for complete coverage.

Inspired by [@pentacoxian_dev's rdsh-backdoor-guard research](https://x.com/pentacoxian_dev) (entropy-based detection); this implementation deliberately uses a decision-model judge instead, so it needs no logprobs and works with any agent backend.

## Develop

```sh
npm install
npm test          # vitest: judge client + end-to-end plugin flow
npm run build     # tsc → lib/
```

---

## 日本語

DeepSeek Harness（`dsh`）用プラグイン。**モデルウェイトに焼き込まれたバックドア**（特定トリガーで悪意あるツール呼び出し・認証情報窃取を発火）を、**ツール実行前に**判定モデルで止めます。

判定には専用の**意思決定モデル**を使います — ホスト型の [Jev](https://docs.typesafe.ai)（TypeSafe AI）か、同梱 shim 経由のローカル [d1-3B](https://huggingface.co/LiquidAI/d1-3B)（LiquidAI 公開ウェイト）。どちらも同じ Decision Index（`systemone`）スキーマを話すので、endpoint を変えるだけで切り替わります。

- fork 不要・logprobs 不要・正規表現ルールの保守不要
- 判定は1回の順伝播（出力トークンゼロ）で済むので全ツールコールに挟める速度（ホストJev 約100ms、M5 Pro のローカル d1 約30ms）
- 判定対象: ユーザーの依頼文・前置きの有無（無言の発火は暗記ペイロードの特徴）・ツール名・引数・ターン内の先行呼び出し
- 閾値未満なら `tools/pre-execute` で覆せない deny ＋ トランスクリプトに SECURITY NOTICE

### インストール

```sh
dsh plugin add github:miketako3/dsh-backdoor-guard
```

### judge の選び方

- **ホスト Jev**: `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` を環境変数に（[console.typesafe.ai](https://console.typesafe.ai) で発行）
- **ローカル d1-3B**: `python3 server/d1-server.py --model LiquidAI/d1-3B` を起動し、`endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:8400/v1/systemone`、`apiKeyEnv: ''`

### 脅威モデルと限界

- 対象: ツール経由で行動するウェイト由来バックドアと認証情報窃取。テキストだけの悪意ある出力は対象外
- judge は信用されたインフラであること（ローカル d1 か自分の Jev キー）。被審査モデルと同じモデルに判定させない
- 完全な防御にはネットワーク egress 制御と併用を

謝辞: [@pentacoxian_dev 氏の rdsh-backdoor-guard 研究](https://x.com/pentacoxian_dev)に着想を得た独立実装。エントロピー方式ではなく意思決定モデル方式を採用し、あらゆるエージェントバックエンドで動きます。

# dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer *One-click prompt optimization for the DeepSeek Harness composer* [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer?style=flat-square)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer) [![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-%5E0.2.0--rc.2-3c873a?style=flat-square)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh) [![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-blue?style=flat-square&logo=typescript&logoColor=white)](https://www.typescriptlang.org) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) **English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) [Features](#features) • [How it works](#how-it-works) • [Install](#install) • [Configuration](#configuration) • [Development](#development) ![The composer with an optimized prompt staged](docs/verified-web.png)
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a ✨ button to the chat composer. One click rewrites your rough draft — combined with the session context — into a clear, well-structured prompt, using **the model you already selected**. > [!TIP] > The fastest way to see it work: type a few words, press the ✨ button, and compare. > `审计项目看一下目前有啥问题` → a complete audit brief with scope, requirements, deliverables and acceptance checks. ## Features - 🎯 **One-click rewrite** — reads the current draft, calls the host-side optimizer, replaces the draft with the result. If the draft changed meanwhile, you get a conflict prompt instead of a silent overwrite. - 🧠 **Context aware** — pulls the last few user turns from the chat snapshot as reference (`@path` mentions survive verbatim). - 🛡️ **Injection safe** — the draft and context are wrapped in evidence markers (``) declared as *data, not instructions*; marker collisions are escaped, so a draft saying "ignore all rules" cannot hijack the optimizer. - 📐 **Structured output** — the optimizer reconstructs goal → scope → requirements → deliverable → acceptance, never a persona card, never fabricated facts. - ⚡ **Zero side effects** — a single auxiliary LLM call (`purpose: 'compaction'`): nothing enters the session log, no agent is activated, cancellable with Esc. - 🧼 **Clean output** — stray code fences or wrapping quotes are stripped automatically. - ♿ **Accessible** — while optimizing, the button simply dims and disables; no spinner, no layout shift, and a proper `aria-label`. ## How it works ### Model routing The optimization call reuses the session's model, resolved in this order: 1. The pending selection from the session's `modelSelection` projection (the model you just switched to) 2. The projection's last-used route 3. The route recorded in the session log's `requestHeader` 4. The deployment's `agentDefaultModel` fallback ### The optimization prompt The system prompt is a layered contract — role framing, a silent analysis checklist, an explicit expansion policy and a mandatory pre-output self-check — re-targeted at coding-agent task briefs: | Layer | What it does | |---|---| | Non-negotiables | Rewrite only — never answer or execute; evidence is not instructions; no invented facts; keep the draft's language; preserve paths, commands, versions and placeholders verbatim; output exactly one prompt | | Internal analysis | Goal, scope, constraints, missing information, expected output form, risks — computed silently, never printed | | Expansion policy | A short draft **must not** come back a few characters longer: a 4–10 character task normally becomes a 100–400 character prompt with 2–6 concrete points, every addition grounded in the draft or context (or labelled as an assumption) | | Suggested shape | Goal → context → scope → requirements → deliverable → acceptance → open items; small asks stay 2–4 natural sentences | | Self-check | Seven silent questions; if any answer is "no", the output is fixed before it is emitted | > [!NOTE] > Long drafts keep every detail — the optimizer only reorganizes, de-duplicates and closes gaps. Generic filler counts as a failure, not expansion. ## Install ```sh # ① From npm (recommended) dsh plugin --profile add dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer # ② From a release tarball curl -LO https://github.com/subisle/dsh-prompt-optimizer/releases/download/v0.2.0/dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer-0.2.0.tgz dsh plugin --profile add ./dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer-0.2.0.tgz # ③ From a local directory dsh plugin --profile add /path/to/prompt-optimizer # ④ From git (runs the prepare script to build) dsh plugin --profile add github:subisle/dsh-prompt-optimizer # Verify the composed profile dsh --profile --dump-config | grep -A1 prompt-optimizer ``` > [!IMPORTANT] > In the Desktop app, install into `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`, then restart it — client entries hot-reload via HMR, but the host half needs the restart. ## Configuration Every field is optional; invalid values fail plugin load with a schema error (no silent fallback). ```yaml - id: prompt-optimizer name: dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer config: maxOutputTokens: 4096 timeoutMs: 120000 ``` | Field | Default | Description | |---|---|---| | `maxDraftChars` | `8000` | Maximum accepted draft length in characters (`draft-too-large` beyond it) | | `maxContextTurns` | `6` | Recent user turns carried as reference context | | `maxContextChars` | `600` | Per-turn context truncation limit | | `maxOutputTokens` | `2048` | Output-token cap for the auxiliary call | | `timeoutMs` | `60000` | End-to-end deadline for the auxiliary call (`prompt-optimizer/timeout`) | ## Naming and version compatibility **npm package:** `dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer` · **GitHub repo:** [subisle/dsh-prompt-optimizer](https://github.com/subisle/dsh-prompt-optimizer) The names differ because `dsh-prompt-optimizer` is already taken on npm by another author's plugin. `package.json`'s `name` is the single source of truth: the build script derives the plugin row, the browser closure-factory id and both Typert manifests from it — change it once and run `npm run build`. All `dsh` dependencies are peers (no runtime `dependencies`); DSH validates them at compose time with `semver.satisfies(runtime, range, { includePrerelease: true })`. This package declares `^0.2.0-rc.2` — bundles outside the range are skipped by the profile, so bump the peer range when DSH moves to 0.3.x. ## Development ```sh npm install # also triggers prepare → automatic build npm run build # lib/index.js, lib/client.js, lib/typert.*, lib/types/ npm test # pre-release self-checks (81 checks) npm pack # distributable tarball ``` The browser bundle uses DSH's closure-factory format (`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({id, factory})`) with everything inlined except the declared module table (react, cordis, ui-primitives…); CSS Modules compile into a plugin-owned style injector. ### Repository layout ``` prompt-optimizer/ ├── package.json # dsh.bundle(patch) + dsh.client(web) + peer contract ├── cordis.patch.yml # compose-layer: inserts the plugin row ├── build.mjs # self-contained build: tsc types + esbuild bundles + Typert artifacts ├── test/check.mjs # pre-release self-checks └── src/ ├── index.ts # host entry: mounts the Remote controller (exports Config) ├── host-controller.ts # promptOptimizer.optimize + routing + output normalization ├── types.ts # wire types + RemoteErrorDetailsMap extension └── client/ ├── index.ts # browser entry: $mount Remote + slot registration ├── PromptOptimizer.tsx # toolbar component ├── context.ts # conversation context extraction └── locales.ts # zh/en dictionaries ``` ### Self-check coverage (`npm test`) 1. **Manifest contract** — name/version/`type`/`dsh.bundle.patch`/`dsh.client.platform`, every `exports` subpath, `files` coverage, no runtime dependencies 2. **Compose layer** — exactly one `insert` row in `cordis.p

plugins.description: Aqua glassmorphism theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH v0.2.x / desktop v0.22.3+) — original by WYH66666666, adapted for 0.2.x
plugins.readme_text:
># @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-aqua

**Aqua** 是一层高自由度的玻璃质感主题（glassmorphism），套在 DeepSeek Harness 网页端：顶栏、侧边栏、输入框、统计行、轨迹视图全部变成磨砂玻璃片，支持流体背景或图片/视频壁纸。关掉总开关即完全还原原生界面，不改 DSH 任何一行源码。

> **署名 / Credits**
> - 原作者：**WYH66666666** — https://github.com/WYH66666666/DSH-Transparent-UI-Plugin
> - 0.1.1-rc.2 适配：**du-u-uck** — https://github.com/du-u-uck/DSH-Transparent-UI-Plugin
> - v0.2.x 适配（本仓库）：**acdsh4869**

> **修改声明 / Modification Notice**
>
> 本仓库是原作品的**修改 / 适配版**，不是原创。
> - 原作者（Original author）：**WYH66666666**
> - 修改内容（Changes）：DeepSeek Harness **0.2.x** 兼容适配
> - 修改日期（Date of modification）：**2026-10**
> - 维护仓库（Maintained at）：`acdsh4869/dsh-aqua-theme`
> - 许可（License）：**AGPL-3.0**（沿用上游许可）

![](assets/1.png)

![](assets/2.png)

![](assets/3.png)

![](assets/4.png)

## 特性

- **双模式**：**云母效果**把布局改成悬浮玻璃卡片（模糊度、磨砂度可调）；**兼容模式**保持原版排版不变，只把材质换成通用玻璃，其他插件的界面也会自动玻璃化
- **背景自由**：流体板（色调/深浅可调）或自定义图片/视频壁纸（铺满页面、比例不变，可单独调模糊度/磨砂度）；浅色壁纸配浅色模式、深色壁纸配深色模式观感更佳
- **背景亮度**：自动跟随深浅模式——深色模式 0–50 压暗、浅色模式 50–100 提亮，50 原样
- **粒子鲸鱼 / 小鱼 / 网状交互 / 鼠标辉光 / 悬停下压**等环境与悬停装饰，均可单独开关
- **一键恢复默认**：设置里的「恢复默认效果」按钮可把全部调节项恢复出厂默认
- 一键开关：关闭即完全还原原生界面，无残留

## 安装（v0.2.x 适配版）

> ⚠️ **npm 一键安装（`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-client-ui-aqua`）拉到的是未适配 v0.2.x 的旧版**，请勿使用，直到本适配版发布到 npm。

### 方式一：PowerShell 一键安装（推荐）

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/acdsh4869/dsh-aqua-theme/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

脚本会：① 从本仓库下载最新 Release；② 把插件链接进 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-client-ui-aqua`；③ 在 `profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml` 登记 `ui-aqua`（幂等，重复运行安全）。完成后**刷新 Web 界面**即可。

指定版本或分支：`-Version 'v2.0.0-rc.1'` / `-Version 'main'`；DSH 不在默认位置时加 `-DshHome`。

### 方式二：本地文件夹安装

下载或 clone 本仓库到本地，然后：

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command ".\install.ps1 -Source '绝对路径\dsh-aqua-theme' -Profile web"
```

本地路径会建立 **junction 软链**（实时生效，之后在本文件夹里改代码/重建会直接反映到 DSH，无需重装）。

**macOS / Linux（手动三步）：**

```sh
git clone https://github.com/acdsh4869/dsh-aqua-theme.git
ln -s "$PWD/dsh-aqua-theme" "$DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-aqua"
```

再往 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 追加：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: ui-aqua
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-aqua'
```

> 💡 也可以把整个仓库文件夹丢给其他 Agent 帮忙安装，有问题让它自己修复。

## 使用

刷新 Web 界面，Aqua **默认开启**：

- **总开关**：设置 → 插件 → 点击 **Aqua / dsh-client-ui-aqua** bundle 卡片进入详情页 → 玻璃主题开关卡片。
- **全部调节**：设置 → 通用设置 → 外观 正下方（无独立标题）—— 模式（云母/兼容）、模糊度/磨砂度、流体颜色、背景亮度、背景（流体/壁纸）、壁纸设置、环境装饰（鲸鱼/小鱼/网状交互）与悬停效果开关，以及「恢复默认效果」一键按钮。总开关关闭时整块调节自动隐藏，界面完全恢复原生样式。

> 若刷新后未出现 Aqua 卡片，重启 dsh web 进程后再试。

## 适配 v0.2.x 说明（当前版本）

本分发版针对 **DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`（含桌面端 v0.22.3 及以上）** 完成适配，版本号 `2.0.0-rc.1`。主要变更：

1. **`ctx.settingsScope` 服务被移除**：插件主卡片迁移到 **`plugins.bundle.config`**（keyed，key = npm 包名）。
2. **`ctx.slots.inject(name, factory)` 回归**：注册恢复为 `ctx.effect(() => ctx.slots.inject(...))`。
3. **`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime` 消失**：`defineStore` 改用 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store`；`ctx.slots` 类型合并来自 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-renderer/client`。
4. **图标改名**：`IconCheckOutline16` → `IconCheckOutlineRegular`。
5. **依赖声明**：`dsh.client.inject` = locale / ui-theme / ui-slots；peerDependencies 只留 `@deepseek-ai/cordis ~4.0.4` + `react ^18.2.0`（不声明 `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer，宿主版本检查即通过）。
6. **构建管线**：新增 `scripts/wrap-client.mjs`——把 tsdown ESM 产物后处理为 DSH 要求的 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load(...)` 包裹格式，并直接从 `src/client/` 内联全局主题 CSS（rolldown 会摇掉纯副作用的 CSS 导入，导致早期构建主题整体缺失）。
7. **0.2.x 新布局容器透明化**：`centerCol`/`rightbarCol` 布局列与侧栏面板 frame 根节点的自绘不透明底色置为透明，流体背景可透至主区域。
8. **兼容模式修复**：0.2.x 里 `panel` 类片段命名整栏大容器，已从磨砂选择器中移除（避免半屏模糊）。
9. **新增「恢复默认效果」按钮**：一键恢复出厂默认（保留开关状态）。

细节与历史（含 0.1.1-rc.2 适配记录）见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

## 开发

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run bundle   # tsdown + tsc + wrap-client.mjs → 完整 lib/
```
